name: IntegrateIT Security Panel
notes: A real Control4 security panel built out of sensors you already own. 32 zones that name themselves from the sensor bound to them, entry delay selectable on any zone, up to 4 garage doors as first-class doors with fully-closed and fully-open limit inputs, the native Navigator Security screen with arm Home and Away, Clear Alarm and per-garage open and close on the functions button, an activity log that survives a reboot, Control4 history records for the push and email notification agents, and a panic button wired to Fire, Medical, Police and Panic. This driver drives no alarm hardware, fires no garage relay, and is not listed alarm signalling.
